description: This source file defines the 'Image' class within the Opencart System Library namespace. It provides functionalities to load, manipulate, resize, watermark, crop, rotate, and save images, including handling different image formats like JPEG, PNG, GIF, and WebP.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: A class for loading, processing, and saving images with support for various formats and operations like resize, crop, rotate, watermark, and filter.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the loaded image.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image resource or object in memory.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: getBits
methods.description: Returns the bits property of the image (color depth).

methods.name: getMime
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the image to a specified file with a given quality for JPEG format.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the image to the specified width and height, with optional default behavior.

methods.name: watermark
methods.description: Applies a watermark to the image at the specified position.

methods.name: crop
methods.description: Crops the image to the specified top-left and bottom-right coordinates.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates the image by a specified degree and applies a color for the background.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies a filter to the image with variable arguments.

methods.name: html2rgb
methods.description: Converts a HTML hex color string to an RGB array.
